body: Source: GitHub issue #1266. dispatchCanary in packages/fleet/bin/fleet.mjs instantiated Sandbox without readOnlyPaths, leaving /usr and /bin unbound on bubblewrap hosts so /bin/sh failed with ENOENT. Export CANARY_SYSTEM_ROOTS ([...SYSTEM_ROOTS, "/bin"]) and canaryReadOnlyPaths(pathExists) in packages/fleet/bin/fleet.mjs and pass readOnlyPaths to Sandbox in dispatchCanary.
criteria: CANARY_SYSTEM_ROOTS includes all SYSTEM_ROOTS plus /bin, and canaryReadOnlyPaths filters to existing host paths.
dispatchCanary passes readOnlyPaths from canaryReadOnlyPaths to Sandbox so bubblewrap binds /usr and /bin.
title: fleet: bind read-only system roots including /bin in preflight canary (#1266)
